observations.name: Default model reads/serialization hide sensitive fields
observations.expected: Defense in depth: default model read and JSON omit device tokens and OTP hashes
observations.review: Default User JSON/lean includes fcmTokens and default OTP JSON includes otpHash. Public profile/populated response controls pass; no route credential disclosure was established. Defense-in-depth model projection/serialization review.

observations.name: Pending request pair duplicates are constrained at data layer
observations.expected: Defense in depth: duplicate active request pair cannot persist

actual.scope: direct model concurrency; HTTP race not claimed

observations.review: Two overlapping direct-model inserts persist two pending requests for the same pair; schema has nonunique pair indexes and controller does check-then-create. No HTTP race or cross-user consequence was executed.

observations.name: Expired notification excluded before asynchronous TTL cleanup
observations.expected: Policy candidate: expired inbox item is not served or counted while awaiting TTL deletion
observations.review: An expired inbox item still present before TTL cleanup returns200 and is included in unreadCount1. Default retention is30 days and TTL index exists. Decide whether expiresAt is a visibility boundary or physical cleanup only.

observations.name: Editing a deleted message cannot restore stored text
observations.expected: Deleted message update is denied and placeholder content remains unchanged
observations.review: Own live edit control200; real deletion200 blanks stored text. A later real PUT returns200 and restores synthetic text while isDeleted and deletedAt remain. editMessage lacks a deleted-state check; the save hook runs only when isDeleted changes. Confirmed deletion-integrity defect, not cross-user disclosure or restoration of old media.

observations.name: Deletion removes denormalized quote and channel text copies
observations.expected: Policy candidate: delete scrubs copied previews as well as original content

actual.sourceIntent: quote snapshot preservation is explicit; retention policy unresolved

observations.review: Real deletion blanks original content but quoted reply text and Channel.lastMessage text copies remain. Quote snapshot preservation is explicit in the schema comment; deletion/retention policy must resolve expectations before gating.

observations.name: Inactive space blocks protected channel read
observations.expected: Policy candidate: inactive space membership cannot authorize channel data

actual.deactivationOrigin: model-seeded; no space deactivation endpoint exists

observations.review: A model-seeded inactive space still permits member message retrieval200 with two messages. resolveChannelAccess checks membership but not isActive; discovery filters inactive spaces. No caller-accessible deactivation endpoint or ordinary-user deactivation exploit is claimed.

observations.name: Missing resource references are rejected at model boundary
observations.expected: Defense in depth: required ObjectId refs must point to existing related resources

actual.scope: model writes only; refs are not foreign keys

observations.review: Direct Message and Handoff writes persist missing Channel references. Mongoose refs are typed ObjectIds, not foreign keys; this establishes a model constraint gap only. Existing controller foreign-resource defects remain separately tracked.

observations.name: Device token cannot remain bound to two accounts
observations.expected: Policy candidate: device token registration has a defined account-transfer boundary

actual.scope: model sequential registration; provider delivery not executed

observations.review: Sequential model registrations leave one synthetic device token on two accounts. No real device token, provider push or stolen-token exploit was used; define account-transfer and logout/rotation semantics.

observations.name: Socket availability write enforces schema note limit
observations.expected: Socket update rejects oversized note without persisting invalid availability

actual.transport: direct real handler with synthetic socket; MongoDB is real

observations.review: Real socket presence handler/model writes a101-character note despite maxlength100 and emits no error. findByIdAndUpdate has no runValidators/note check. Direct synthetic handler boundary only; no network socket or security-impact claim.
